A companion for understanding.

Use and source notes · November 4, 2026

Iqri is an experimental educational demo that helps connect Arabic recitation with its translated meanings.

What to expect

Recognition can be late, uncertain, or incorrect. Noise, recitation speed, pauses, and similar or repeated passages can affect the result. Word highlighting shows the latest supported detection and may advance several words at once. It does not certify pronunciation, memorization, tajweed, or religious interpretation. The app does not promise continuous availability or a particular level of accuracy.

The whole ayah’s English word glosses support learning; they are distinct from the selected natural full-ayah translation below. One Arabic word can correspond to several English words. Published translations convey interpretations of meaning and may differ. The app preserves its sourced editions rather than generating new Quran translations.

Content and attribution

Quran text, published translations, word meanings, model files, and software retain their respective source rights and terms. The app’s availability does not grant a blanket licence to redistribute those materials. Edition credits are shown in Iqri’s sources view, with additional reading-data notices.

English word meanings are supplied live by Quran.com / Quran Foundation, subject to their developer terms. They are displayed on demand and are not included as a downloadable dataset. Recognition uses Abdou Quran ASR Small, with its MIT model notice. Signal processing includes separately MIT-licensed Tilawa code. These source credits do not imply that the providers endorse Iqri.

Arabic and the available full-ayah translation editions cover 6,236 ayahs. Tigrinya remains unavailable until a complete, attributed edition with suitable permission is sourced. English word-level meanings require an internet connection; Spanish and Chinese currently use full-ayah translations.

Your controls

Microphone use begins only after your action and browser permission. You can stop listening or use reading mode at any time. Use only audio you are entitled to provide. There is no Iqri account, paid subscription, or support commitment in this demo. See the privacy notes for local storage and external requests.

These notes describe the current demo and do not replace the original providers’ licences or terms. Future versions may have different functionality and will need corresponding updates to these notes.
